figures.caption: Figure 1: Framework overview. Solid arrows are per-step dataflow: the environment emits state st and its caption ϕ(st); the LLM planner produces the active subgoal gt and a bounded potential score Φ(s, g); the RL policy πθ selects action at conditioned on both st and gt; the shaping term F = γΦ(s′, g) −Φ(s, g) is added to the environment reward. Dashed arrows are periodic: the memory drives policy updates and, on the schedule of Section 4.4, triggers plan revisions.
